variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: 7.62x51mm
variants.info: Converts the MCX SPEAR into firing traditional 7.62x51mm NATO. Increases overall damage to perform like a true battle rifle but lowers fire rate, bullet speed and penetration due to the slower bullet!

variants.name: 6.5mm
variants.info: Converts your weapon to fire 6.5mm Creedmoor. Uses a 25rd magazine and improves recoil but lowers overall damage and penetration performance!
